description: Real UC menu snapshots and venue metadata for prototype development. Original menu dates are preserved. Empty menus do not establish closure; failed requests do not establish absence. This is not a live availability feed.
warning: Missing or empty allergen information does not establish allergen absence. Shared equipment and surfaces can cause cross-contact. Menus and recipes can change; confirm dietary needs with UC Dining.
nutrition_units: Values without explicit source units use conventional units supplied by the normalizer. Raw strings are retained; null is not zero.

locations.name: Pei Wei
locations.description: Pei Wei at Tangeman University Center offers authentic, Asian-inspired cuisine without compromising on quality or convenience.

locations.name: MarketPointe
locations.description: MarketPointe is a 37,000 foot state-of-the-art dining facility that boasts 8 dining stations that put you at the center of a culinary food hall experience. From delicious, plant-forward dishes and nourishing made-to-order sandwiches to authentic global bowls and craveable Latin-infused flavors, MarketPointe has something for everyone. Simple Servings at MarketPointe provides safe and appetizing food choices for our guests with food allergies or gluten intolerance. All foods served at this station are prepared with ingredients that do not contain 8 of the top 9 allergens, plus gluten. Cap your dining experience with a fresh-roasted cup of local Rooted Grounds coffee and something sweet.

locations.name: Halal Shack

address.name: The Halal Shack - Tangeman University Center

locations.description: At The Halal Shack, our food is Made with Love. Our culture is rooted in Middle Eastern & Mediterranean heritage which embodies bonds that are created through sharing food Made With Love. Find us at Tangeman University Center.

locations.name: The 86 Coffee Bar
locations.description: Partnering with the local Pneuma Coffee Roasters, renowned for their commitment to quality, The 86 Coffee Bar offers an array of meticulously crafted brews, from rich espressos to velvety lattes. Moreover, the menu extends beyond traditional offerings, with specialty drinks inspired by the creativity of CCM's community.

locations.name: On The Green

address.name: On The Green - Marian Spencer Hall

locations.description:
On the Green is an all-you-care-to-eat dining facility that boasts 8 dining stations, dishing up comfort food classics, made-to-order stir-fry and pasta, homemade soups, fresh salads with local greens, and in-house baked desserts. Simple Servings at On The Green provides safe and appetizing food choices for our guests with food allergies or gluten intolerance. All foods served at this station are prepared with ingredients that do not contain 8 of the top 9 allergens, plus gluten. On The Green is also home to the Simple Zone, a “pantry” where food items needed by customers with celiac disease or food allergies can be housed with precautions against cross-contact can be found. ![CertificationGreenRestaurantLogo](/web/en-us/media/CertificationGreenRestaurantLogo_tcm17-85246.png "CertificationGreenRestaurantLogo") [Green Restaurant Association](https://www.dinegreen.com/g/res19292 "CertificationGreenRestaurantLogo") On the Green is proud to be a 4 Star Certified Green Restaurant! All of our sustainable practices are verified by the Green Restaurant Association, a national non-profit helping restaurants become more sustainable.
## 513 Green Certified ![513GreenCertified](/web/en-us/media/513GreenCertified_tcm17-89984.png "513GreenCertified") Sustainability is a core component of On the Green Dining’s operations at the University of Cincinnati. Operated by Sodexo, the program supports UC’s commitment to environmental stewardship through a variety of initiatives designed to reduce its environmental footprint and promote responsible dining practices. Efforts include reducing food waste through donation and recovery programs, expanding recycling and composting opportunities, and sourcing ingredients responsibly with an emphasis on local and regional suppliers whenever possible. On the Green Dining also participates in sustainability programs that encourage resource conservation, waste diversion, and sustainable purchasing. Dining locations utilize reusable and recyclable materials where feasible, and educational campaigns help students make informed choices about food consumption and waste reduction. Through partnerships with campus and community organizations, the program works to divert surplus food, support local agriculture, and advance UC’s broader sustainability goals. These initiatives help create a more environmentally responsible dining experience while fostering a culture of sustainability across the University of Cincinnati community.

locations.description: DAAP Café serves your favorite breakfast, lunch, and dinner options. The Café also serves Simply to Go sandwiches, salads, & snacks for students who are hungry and on the go. If you need a pick-me-up, we also serve iced bubble tea and Rooted Grounds coffee.

locations.name: Cincy Grill
locations.description: Located on the second floor of the Tangeman University Center, Cincy Grill is home to grill favorites such as chicken tenders, smash burgers, loaded tots and much more.

locations.name: Shake Smart

address.name: Located in the Campus Rec Center

locations.description:
Shake Smart was founded in 2011 by two students at San Diego State University who found it difficult to find healthy options while living the college on-the-go lifestyle. Their vision was to make healthy eating more accessible and to have a balance of nutrients focusing specifically on protein. Now with over 60 locations across the country & our own protein powder brand, we continue to spread our vision of healthy convenience.

Find Shake Smart inside of the Campus Rec Center.

locations.name: Bearcat Social
locations.description:
Bearcats Social, located in TUC offers both a grab and go style meal or a hot meal to go.


BABB (Bad-Ass Breakfast Burritos) - Satisfy your early-morning or late-night cravings with burritos packed with premium meats, crispy potatoes, cheese, and eggs, all wrapped in a soft tortilla. Top it off with our addictive sauces for a truly satisfying meal.

CincyXSeoul - Get ready for a flavor-packed journey from Cincinnati to Seoul with CincyxSeoul, 513 Culinary’s newest Korean Fried Chicken! Enjoy crispy, craveable chicken tossed in bold Korean-inspired sauces and unforgettable flavors. CincyxSeoul brings Seoul’s street food energy straight to campus.
